clusters.title: CLI Session Management and Stability Improvements
clusters.summary: Users want improved CLI session handling including better startup status display, session resumption via --resume flag, and fixes for sessions disappearing from the sidebar. They're also asking for stability improvements like preventing hangs with large files, better token limit handling, and fixes for command recognition and argument parsing issues.
clusters.representative_need: Accept .plugin file extension in plugin upload and propagate specific error messages to the UI
sample_titles: Accept .plugin file extension in plugin upload and propagate specific error messages to the UI
Add 'Delegate to Agent' option to plan mode for executing plans via subagent with isolated context
Add 'Enable auto-mode' option to permission request dialogs to allow users to re-enable auto-mode and approve queued requests in one action

clusters.title: Custom commands in .claude/commands/ not recognized
clusters.summary: Users are reporting that custom commands they create in the .claude/commands/ directory are not being recognized by the CLI. This prevents users from using their custom slash commands, disrupting their workflow and productivity.
clusters.representative_need: Fix custom commands not being recognized from .claude/commands/
sample_titles: Fix custom commands not being recognized from .claude/commands/
Fix custom slash commands in ~/.claude/commands/ not being recognized

clusters.title: Reduce excessive token consumption
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing excessive token usage during both simple prompts and failed operations, leading to unnecessary resource consumption and increased costs. They want the system to optimize token usage to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
clusters.representative_need: Fix excessive token consumption during simple prompts
sample_titles: Fix excessive token consumption during simple prompts
Fix excessive token usage consumption during failed operations

clusters.title: Fix excessive token consumption
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing excessive token consumption both during extended usage sessions and in sudden spikes. This leads to increased operational costs and potential performance degradation. Users want these consumption issues identified and resolved to achieve more efficient and predictable token usage.
clusters.representative_need: Fix excessive token consumption during extended usage sessions
sample_titles: Fix excessive token consumption during extended usage sessions
Fix excessive token consumption spike

clusters.title: Preserve transcript and history during subagent execution
clusters.summary: Users need transcript and terminal history to persist reliably during subagent execution. Currently, both disappear unexpectedly when subagents run, disrupting workflow continuity and making it difficult to review what happened. This data loss impacts debugging, auditing, and overall user confidence in the system's reliability.
clusters.representative_need: Fix terminal history disappearing during sub-agent execution
sample_titles: Fix terminal history disappearing during sub-agent execution
Fix transcript disappearing during subagent execution

clusters.title: Companion UI visibility toggle setting
clusters.summary: Users want the ability to disable or hide companion UI elements (like Clatter or Welkin) through a configuration setting. This gives users control over their interface, allowing them to reduce visual clutter or hide elements they don't use.
clusters.representative_need: Add setting to disable Companion (Clatter) UI element
sample_titles: Add setting to disable Companion (Clatter) UI element
Add setting to hide Welkin companion UI element

clusters.title: Fix Unexpected High Resource Consumption
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing unexpectedly high token and API usage consumption and need investigation tools and fixes to identify and resolve the root causes. This impacts cost management and operational efficiency.
clusters.representative_need: Fix unexpected high token consumption rate
sample_titles: Fix unexpected high token consumption rate
Investigate and fix unexpected API usage consumption
Investigate and fix unexpected high token usage

clusters.title: Fix MCP connectors not loading in Remote Trigger
clusters.summary: Users report that MCP cloud connectors and OAuth-based MCP connector credentials fail to load when executing in a Remote Trigger environment. This breaks workflows that depend on MCP integrations, preventing developers from using their configured connectors in remote/triggered executions.
clusters.representative_need: Fix MCP cloud connectors not loading in Remote Trigger execution environment
sample_titles: Fix MCP cloud connectors not loading in Remote Trigger execution environment
Fix OAuth MCP connector credentials not loading in remote trigger execution environment

clusters.title: Add settings to disable companion features
clusters.summary: Users want the ability to disable various companion features like the pet in the TUI, companion buddy, and system-injected task reminders. These optional features are not useful for all users, so providing settings to disable them would improve user experience and reduce distractions.
clusters.representative_need: Add setting to disable companion buddy
sample_titles: Add setting to disable companion buddy
Add setting to disable companion pet in the TUI
Add setting to disable system-injected task reminders

clusters.title: Fix rate limit false positive errors
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing false positive rate limit errors even when their usage is well below limits or shows 0%. These incorrect error triggers cause unnecessary interruptions and reduce trust in the rate limiting system. Users need accurate rate limit detection that only triggers when limits are actually exceeded.
clusters.representative_need: Fix false positive rate limit errors when usage is well below limits
sample_titles: Fix false positive rate limit errors when usage is well below limits
Fix false positive rate limit errors when usage shows 0%

clusters.title: Linux Voice Dictation Dropping Words
clusters.summary: Users on Linux are experiencing voice dictation that drops words and sentences, failing to reliably capture spoken input. This intermittent failure causes incomplete dictation and lost content. The issue appears specific to the Linux platform and requires fixes to ensure reliable speech-to-text capture.
clusters.representative_need: Fix voice dictation dropping words and failing to capture input intermittently on Linux
sample_titles: Fix voice dictation dropping words and failing to capture input intermittently on Linux
Fix voice dictation dropping words and sentences on Linux

clusters.title: Fix Cowork virtualization detection on Windows Hyper-V
clusters.summary: Users on Windows 11 with properly enabled Hyper-V report that Cowork fails to detect virtualization, even when all related features and services are running correctly. This detection failure prevents Cowork from functioning properly on these systems, requiring users to find workarounds or disable Hyper-V entirely. The issue appears consistent across different Windows 11 versions and configurations.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Cowork virtualization detection failure on Windows
sample_titles: Fix Cowork virtualization detection failure on Windows
Fix Cowork virtualization detection failure on Windows 11 Pro 24H2 when Hyper-V is enabled and all services are running
Fix Cowork virtualization detection failure on Windows 11 when Hyper-V and related features are properly enabled

clusters.title: Fix macOS 26 Tahoe compatibility issues
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing native macOS bridge and accessibility module initialization failures when running the computer-use MCP server on macOS 26 (Tahoma). These platform-specific initialization issues prevent the server from functioning correctly on the new macOS version, requiring fixes to the native bridge code and accessibility module to ensure proper compatibility.
clusters.representative_need: Fix accessibility module initialization failure in computer-use MCP server on macOS 26 Tahoe
sample_titles: Fix accessibility module initialization failure in computer-use MCP server on macOS 26 Tahoe
Fix native macOS bridge initialization for computer-use MCP server on macOS 26 (Tahoe)

clusters.title: Companion Species Selection and Customization
clusters.summary: Users want to select different species for their /buddy companions and have customization options available. This would allow users to personalize their companion experience by choosing preferred species and tailoring their appearance or attributes to their liking.
clusters.representative_need: Add companion species selection for the /buddy feature
sample_titles: Add companion species selection for the /buddy feature
Add species selection and customization options for the /buddy companion feature

clusters.title: Add game metadata fields to statusline JSON
clusters.summary: Users want additional game state information exposed in the statusline JSON output, specifically exchange/turn count and effort level. This allows developers and external tools to programmatically access these metrics for analysis, automation, or integration with other systems.
clusters.representative_need: Add effort level to statusLine JSON data
sample_titles: Add effort level to statusLine JSON data
Add exchange/turn count to statusline JSON data

clusters.title: Fix undefined property access TypeErrors in MCP
clusters.summary: Users encounter TypeErrors when using the computer-use MCP server because code attempts to call methods (checkAccessibility, registerEscape) on undefined objects. These runtime errors cause tools to fail and crash the application. The issues indicate initialization or dependency access problems that need proper null/undefined checks or correct ordering of setup code.
clusters.representative_need: Fix 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'registerEscape')' error when calling computer-use MCP tools
sample_titles: Fix 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'registerEscape')' error when calling computer-use MCP tools
Fix TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading checkAccessibility)' in computer-use MCP server

clusters.title: Preserve Execute Permissions on Bundled Binaries
clusters.summary: Users expect bundled binaries to retain their execute permissions during npm installation and package upgrades. When permissions are lost, the binaries become unusable, breaking the package's core functionality. This issue particularly affects packages that ship vendor tools like ripgrep.
clusters.representative_need: Preserve execute permissions on bundled binaries (ripgrep) during package upgrade
sample_titles: Preserve execute permissions on bundled binaries (ripgrep) during package upgrade
Preserve execute permissions on bundled vendor binaries during npm installation

clusters.summary: Users are experiencing degradation in the model's ability to follow instructions after context compression is applied. This includes both immediate degradation and progressive worsening over time with continued use. The issue suggests a bug in how context compression affects the model's instruction-following capabilities.
clusters.representative_need: Fix instruction-following degradation after context compression
sample_titles: Fix instruction-following degradation after context compression
Fix progressive instruction-following degradation after context compression

clusters.title: Companion name customization via settings
clusters.summary: Users want the ability to customize the name of their companion character or buddy through configuration settings. This allows for personalization of the user experience, making interactions with the companion feel more tailored and engaging for individual users.
